reviews.title: No updates for 9 months
reviews.text: Sleep tracking improved a little around mid-2025 but has gone totally crazy since iPhone iOS 26.2. It was never as accurate as Fitbit or even an old app I still use. My Mi Band 7 rates in the Low to Low-Mid range by The Quantified Scientist on YouTube, well below most serious, competitive devices. Even the Mi Band 6 rated better and newer Mi Band devices seem to actually be getting worse at sleep tracking. Mi Band seems to pay little serious attention at keeping the device up, with only 4 updates of the app in 2024. Who knows what, if any, software was updated on the devices themselves. The degradation in sleep tracking occurring after Apple iOS 26 has me considering a switch to another device that is cared for better. Speaking of care, Customer Care has literally been non-existent over the many years I’ve owned Mi Bands 5, 6 & 7. I have written with questions or suggestions at least 3 times over the years and never even received the courtesy of a reply - not even a robot automated one. Mi Band seems to be falling into the ranks of the Cheap Toy Trackers, unfortunately.

reviews.title: Issues with accurate time
reviews.text: It used to keep accurate time when I fell asleep. Now it is off by several hours. It will say I fell asleep at 10:30 when I fell asleep at 8:30.
